cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 evaluates the index x + 32'd1 of an associative array with a bit [63:0] index at the expression's own 32 bits, so the element is stored under key 0. IEEE 1800-2023 7.8.4 evaluates an integral index as a cast to the index type, and 6.24.1 gives a size cast the value after an assignment to that width, so the key is 64'h100000000; xezim 0.11.3 also stores key 0.
